<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#08080C"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="17" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">9:41</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="11" x2="321" y2="17" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="9" x2="325" y2="17" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="7" x2="329" y2="17" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="5" x2="333" y2="17" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="12" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="12" x2="348" y2="8" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="12" x2="351" y2="14" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="6" width="19" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="8" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <rect x="380" y="10" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FAFAFD"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,53 21,60 28,67" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="60" x2="37" y2="60" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="66" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Network Settings</text>
    <circle cx="363" cy="60" r="16" fill="#212131"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="60" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="60" r="2" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <rect x="362" y="41" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <rect x="362" y="73" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <rect x="344" y="59" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <rect x="376" y="59" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Content intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="107" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Connectivity</text>
    <text x="20" y="129" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Configure the network used for trading and account data.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Current network card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="151" width="350" height="92" rx="8" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="20" y="149" width="350" height="92" rx="8" fill="#29293D" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="181" r="18" fill="#7A57DD"/>
    <polygon points="51,165 57,176 55,190 47,190 45,176" fill="#FAFAFD" opacity=".9"/>
    <text x="82" y="176" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">ACTIVE NETWORK</text>
    <text x="82" y="198" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Ethereum Mainnet</text>
    <rect x="262" y="169" width="80" height="22" rx="4" fill="#3ED9A433"/>
    <circle cx="274" cy="180" r="4" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <text x="284" y="184" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#3ED9A4">Connected</text>
    <text x="82" y="222" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Chain ID 1</text>
    <text x="177" y="222" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Latency 42 ms</text>
    <polyline points="350,185 355,190 350,195" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Network selection -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="275" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Network</text>
    <rect x="20" y="286" width="350" height="56" rx="8" fill="#29293D" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="314" r="12" fill="#7A57DD"/>
    <polygon points="43,303 47,311 46,323 40,323 39,311" fill="#FAFAFD"/>
    <text x="66" y="319" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5" font-weight="450" fill="#FAFAFD">Ethereum Mainnet</text>
    <polyline points="342,310 347,315 352,310" fill="none" stroke="#AFAEC0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- RPC endpoint -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="377" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">RPC endpoint</text>
    <rect x="20" y="388" width="350" height="56" rx="8" fill="#29293D" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="32" y="422" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">https://mainnet.infura.io/v3/••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="416" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <polyline points="343,416 346,419 351,413" fill="none" stroke="#3ED9A4" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="20" y="461" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Endpoint verified  •  Last checked just now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Advanced settings -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="501" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Advanced settings</text>
    <rect x="20" y="513" width="350" height="126" rx="8" fill="#212131" stroke="#303045" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="32" y="541" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">Auto-select fastest endpoint</text>
    <text x="32" y="560" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Improve reliability during high traffic</text>
    <rect x="316" y="527" width="40" height="24" rx="12" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="539" r="9" fill="#FAFAFD"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="574" x2="358" y2="574" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="32" y="599" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">Use secure WebSocket</text>
    <text x="32" y="618" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Required for real-time market updates</text>
    <rect x="316" y="585" width="40" height="24" rx="12" fill="#38384D" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="328" cy="597" r="9" fill="#6966FF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="665" width="168" height="42" rx="6" fill="#303045" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="104" y="691" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13.5" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">Reset to default</text>
    <rect x="198" y="665" width="172" height="42" rx="6" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <text x="284" y="691" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13.5" font-weight="500" fill="#08080C">Save changes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="750" width="390" height="94" fill="#181825" stroke="#303045" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Portfolio -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="37,774 48,765 59,774" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="40" y="773" width="16" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="48" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Portfolio</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Markets -->
    <g>
      <line x1="111" y1="785" x2="111" y2="775" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="117" y1="785" x2="117" y2="770" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="123" y1="785" x2="123" y2="778" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="108,773 114,769 119,775 127,767" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="119" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Markets</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Trade -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="777" r="13" fill="#6966FF"/>
      <line x1="189" y1="777" x2="201" y2="777" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="195" y1="771" x2="195" y2="783" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="195" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#FAFAFD">Trade</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Alerts -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="269" cy="766" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="261" y="769" width="16" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="279" cy="767" r="3" fill="#E45555"/>
      <text x="269" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Alerts</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="342" cy="771" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="342" cy="782" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="342" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
